The team, led by coach Mohamed Ouahbi, plays organized football and will be looking to replicate their best-ever result of reaching the semi-finals at the 2005 World Cup.

Norway U20 vs France U20: Watch Live Stream Online - U20 World Cup 2025 Quarter-final 13.10.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of the final quarter-final match of the FIFA U-20 World Cup 2025 in Chile, where Norway will face France. Both teams advanced to this stage after dramatic extra-time victories and will now determine the last semi-finalist of the tournament at the Estadio Elías Figueroa Brander in Valparaíso.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 13, 2025, 02:00 MSK (23:00 UTC October 12).

Match Preview and Team Form

Norway has already achieved a historic success by reaching the knockout stage of the U-20 World Cup for the first time. The team displays exceptionally organized and defensive football, having conceded only one goal in four matches at the tournament. Norway finished second in their group and defeated Paraguay 1-0 in extra time in the Round of 16. The team is unbeaten in their last six matches and is known for its resilience.

France, despite an inconsistent performance in the group stage where they finished third, is one of the tournament favorites. 'Les Bleuets' qualified for the knockout stage as the top-ranked third-placed team. In the Round of 16, the French also overcame Japan in extra time (1-0), scoring the decisive goal from a penalty in the 123rd minute. The team possesses strong attacking potential but has struggled with finishing.

Head-to-Head History

The head-to-head history between these youth national teams is entirely in favor of France. 'Les Bleuets' have won both previous encounters. These matches were friendlies and took place in 2018 and 2019.

Norway U20 vs France U20 Prediction

Experts and bookmakers consider France to be the favorite in the upcoming match. Despite Norway's impressive defense, the superior individual quality and experience of the French players are expected to be the deciding factors.

  • Likely Outcome: A victory for France.
  • Total Goals Bet: Both teams have shown low scoring in the knockout stage, and Norway's last eight games have all finished with under 2.5 goals. A bet on 'Under 2.5 goals' looks highly probable.
  • Key Factor: The contest between Norway's solid defense and France's attacking potential. The fate of the match will likely be decided by a single goal.

Tune into the Norway U20 vs France U20 live stream on tutsport.net and follow the decisive games of the U-20 World Cup!
